FIELDS.NAME: Sweet Indulgence Desserts
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Sweet Indulgence Desserts, we specialize in serving a wide range of delectable treats including cakes, pastries, cookies, and gourmet desserts, crafted using high-quality ingredients. Our operations revolve around a well-organized retail environment that emphasizes customer experience, cleanliness, and safety. We maintain strict compliance with all health department regulations, ensuring our kitchen and serving areas meet the highest standards of hygiene and safety. With a focus on seasonal offerings and limited-time promotions, we cater to an ever-changing customer base while training our staff in responsible service practices. Our commitment to quality and safety extends to thorough risk management practices, including regular training sessions for all employees, routine inspections of equipment, and prompt corrective actions for any past operational concerns. Ultimately, our goal is to provide a delightful experience where customers can indulge in sweet creations in a safe and inviting atmosphere.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/10/2023, a small fire occurred in the kitchen due to a grease buildup, resulting in damage to kitchen equipment amounting to $1,200. The fire was quickly contained, and no injuries were reported. We completed restoration and implemented updated cleaning protocols to prevent future incidents. Currently, the status of this claim is closed.
FIELDS.ADDRESS: 456 Sweet Treat Blvd, Dessert City, CA 90210-1234
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Commercial-grade safe, Class I, UL-listed, fire-resistant, 1-hour rating.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and motion-activated security cameras installed around the perimeter to enhance safety and deter potential theft or vandalism.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Sweet Indulgence Desserts does not involve the storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting of hazardous materials in its operations. The focus is solely on food preparation and retail sales of desserts.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Sweet Indulgence Desserts does not sponsor any athletic teams as our focus is on providing high-quality dessert products and services to our customers.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance, as this is essential for risk management. The certificates are checked by our management team to ensure compliance.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Sweet Indulgence Desserts has not had any applicants indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Sweet Indulgence Desserts has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. We maintain a good standing with our insurance carrier and have addressed any past claims appropriately.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Sweet Indulgence Desserts does not lease employees to or from other employers, as we maintain our own staff to ensure consistent quality and service in our operations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Sweet Indulgence Desserts does not currently carry Workers Compensation insurance. However, we maintain all required safety protocols and ensure compliance with state regulations regarding employee coverage.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Sweet Indulgence Desserts operates another business called Sweet Treats Bakery. This additional venture complements our dessert offerings and allows us to diversify our products and services.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Sweet Indulgence Desserts does not have any other insurance with this company at this time. Currently, our sole policy is for the business itself.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Sweet Indulgence Desserts does not engage in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; we solely focus on retail sales of desserts prepared in our kitchen.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Sweet Indulgence Desserts does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations focus solely on the retail sale of desserts. This practice helps us maintain control over our equipment and ensures compliance with safety standards.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Sweet Indulgence Desserts has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The company maintains a stable financial position and continues to operate successfully.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Sweet Indulgence Desserts does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals in its operations, as our focus is solely on food preparation and retail sales of desserts. All practices are in compliance with health and safety regulations.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Sweet Indulgence Desserts does not have any catastrophe exposure, as our operations are focused on food preparation and retail sales of desserts without involvement in high-risk activities. We maintain strict compliance with safety protocols and have successfully managed previous incidents with thorough corrective actions.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Sweet Indulgence Desserts has no past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business maintains a strong focus on compliance and risk management practices.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Sweet Indulgence Desserts currently has no uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring that all safety measures are in compliance and up to date.

reviews: Sweet Indulgence Desserts is a hidden gem! Their chocolate cake is to die for, and the staff is always friendly.
I love the seasonal flavors they offer! The pumpkin spice cupcakes were a delightful treat this fall.
The ambiance is cozy, perfect for enjoying a dessert with friends. Highly recommend their signature cheesecake!
I visited for the first time and was impressed by the cleanliness and the variety of desserts available.
Their gourmet cookies are the best in town! Can't wait to come back and try more of their delicious offerings.
